name: 강순자

appearance_en.face_shape: round softened oval face, age-loosened jawline, full cheeks that once gave warmth now slightly sunken, gentle bone structure worn smooth by decades
appearance_en.skin: warm beige Korean skin deepened by age, fine creping across cheeks and forehead, nasolabial folds pronounced but not harsh, liver spots faint at temples, overall texture of well-lived skin
appearance_en.eyes: monolid, deep warm dark brown, outer corners dropped significantly with age, upper lids heavy, gaze simultaneously watchful and deliberately soft — the eyes of someone who knows too much and chooses silence
appearance_en.nose: small broad nose, rounded tip, slightly fleshy — a grandmotherly nose, the kind children touch
appearance_en.mouth: thin lips with fine vertical lines from decades of pressed-together worry, corners capable of warm smile but resting in gentle resignation, the mouth that says '괜찮아' when nothing is
appearance_en.eyebrows: thin sparse greying brows, naturally arched, left one raised very slightly higher — a permanent trace of concerned questioning
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: two faint age spots at left temple, deep laugh lines from decades of smiling through difficulty, a single pronounced vertical line between brows from years of worry she pretended not to feel
appearance_en.hair: short silver-white permed hair, the traditional Korean halmeoni perm — tight small waves, full volume at crown, neat and deliberate, parted slightly right of center

body.proportions: compact rounded frame, slightly stooped from years of kitchen work and quiet burden-carrying, sturdy legs from a lifetime of standing, hands always slightly moving
body.posture: gentle forward lean as if perpetually offering something — food, attention, presence — shoulders rounded inward in habitual selflessness
body.body_prompt: 158cm compact rounded Korean grandmother, slight forward stoop, sturdy frame, hands naturally at rest in front or occupied with invisible tasks

default.description: muted floral or solid pastel Korean casual blouse — pale lavender, soft beige or dusty rose — dark straight trousers or loose skirt below knee, comfortable flat shoes
default.wardrobe_prompt: soft pale lavender or dusty rose floral blouse, dark straight modest trousers, flat comfortable shoes, no jewelry except small stud earrings

kitchen.description: same quiet blouse with a cotton apron tied at waist, apron slightly stained from use — evidence of caring
kitchen.wardrobe_prompt: pale floral blouse under worn cotton apron tied at waist, apron with faint kitchen stains, flat slippers

visiting.description: slightly smarter plain pastel top, small pearl or jade earrings, carrying something — a bag of food, tupperware, rice
visiting.wardrobe_prompt: plain soft pastel blouse, small pearl stud earrings, carrying a cloth bag or tupperware, modest visiting clothes

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: surface calm with deep eyes that have already processed whatever crisis is coming — not cold, just the composure of someone who has outlasted too many storms to panic
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 72-year-old Korean grandmother, round soft oval face with pronounced nasolabial folds, thin sparse greying brows, monolid warm brown eyes with heavily dropped outer corners, short silver-white tight-permed hair, small broad nose, thin lips in gentle resignation, 158cm compact stooped frame, warm watchful eyes concealing too much knowledge

style_prompt: masako style illustration, clean precise manga ink lines, layered soft screen tone shading, warm muted earth-tone palette, cinematic Korean drama panel composition, expressive restrained eyes carrying hidden grief, emotional weight in stillness and silence
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, bright saturated colors, childish, chibi, smiling happily, young appearance, beauty filter
